annotations.title: Flag an answer or send feedback

description: Flags an OpenCancer answer for human expert review, or sends feedback to the OpenCancer team. Used when the user says an OpenCancer answer was wrong, unsafe, or incomplete, or wants to tell OpenCancer something (answer_id identifies the answer; message holds the user's words). Also used to report that an OpenCancer tool returned no usable answer (kind "missing_answer" with answer_id or tool, no message). Feedback is read by the OpenCancer team; it is not an urgent-care channel and no reply is sent through it.

answer_id.description: Optional. The answer id from an OpenCancer answer.

kind.description: wrong_or_unsafe, missing_answer, bug, idea, or praise.

message.description: Optional. The user's feedback in their own words. Contact details are not accepted.

tool.description: Optional. Which OpenCancer tool this is about.

name: send_feedback
title: Flag an answer or send feedback
